topics.topic: Introduction to Marketing: Definition, marketing philosophy, and role in Nigerian economic growth
learningObjectives: Define marketing according to the Chartered Institute of Marketing (CIM) and American Marketing Association (AMA)
Distinguish between marketing, selling, and advertising
Explain the importance of marketing in wealth creation, employment, and living standards in Nigeria

topics.topic: Evolution of Marketing Concepts: Production, product, selling, marketing, and societal marketing
learningObjectives: Trace the historical progression of business orientations from the Industrial Revolution to date
Compare the inward focus of the production concept with the consumer focus of the marketing concept
Explain the societal marketing concept balancing corporate profits, consumer satisfaction, and public welfare

topics.topic: Marketing Environment: Micro-environment (suppliers, customers, competitors) and Macro-environment
learningObjectives: Identify internal and external actors influencing marketing operations
Analyze macro-environmental PESTEL forces (political, economic, socio-cultural, technological, environmental, legal)
Examine how inflation and exchange rates affect commercial purchasing in Nigerian retail markets

topics.topic: Consumer Markets vs Organizational/Industrial Markets: Characteristics and buying motives
learningObjectives: Differentiate between B2C (Business-to-Consumer) and B2B (Business-to-Business) market structures
Analyze emotional and rational buying motives influencing domestic household purchases
Explain organizational buying characteristics: derived demand, formal purchasing procedures, and buying centers

topics.topic: The Marketing Mix: The Traditional 4 Ps (Product, Price, Place, Promotion) and Modern 7 Ps
learningObjectives: Explain each of the 4 Ps and their strategic integration in market campaigns
Introduce the extended 3 Ps for services marketing: People, Process, and Physical Evidence
Formulate a balanced marketing mix strategy for a newly introduced consumer beverage in Lagos

topics.topic: Product Planning and Classification: Consumer goods and industrial goods
learningObjectives: Define a product as a bundle of tangible and intangible satisfaction
Classify consumer goods into convenience, shopping, specialty, and unsought goods
Classify industrial goods into raw materials, capital items, manufactured parts, and supplies

topics.topic: Mid-Term Continuous Assessment & Business Case Study Simulation
learningObjectives: Assess student comprehension of marketing concepts, environmental scanning, and the 4 Ps
Evaluate student case study analysis diagnosing declining product sales in local retail stores
Provide remedial instruction on distinguishing between selling and customer-oriented marketing

topics.topic: Product Life Cycle (PLC): Introduction, growth, maturity, and decline stages
learningObjectives: Draw and label the standard S-shaped Product Life Cycle curve
Describe sales volume, cost structures, competition, and profits across each PLC stage
Formulate marketing strategies for reviving mature consumer brands facing decline

topics.topic: Branding, Packaging, and Labeling: Strategic roles in consumer product differentiation
learningObjectives: Define brand name, trademark, brand equity, and brand loyalty
Explain protective, promotional, and informational functions of packaging
Detail statutory labeling requirements mandated by NAFDAC and SON on packaged goods

topics.topic: Pricing Concepts and Strategies: Cost-plus, skimming, penetration, and psychological pricing
learningObjectives: Explain internal and external factors influencing pricing decisions
Calculate selling prices using cost-plus / markup pricing models in Naira
Differentiate market skimming for innovative electronics from penetration pricing for everyday FMCG products

topics.topic: Salesmanship: Attributes of an effective sales representative and sales ethics
learningObjectives: Define personal selling and highlight qualities of successful salespeople (product knowledge, empathy, resilience)
Explain stages in the personal selling process (prospecting, pre-approach, approach, presentation, closing, follow-up)
Examine professional sales ethics and avoiding deceitful claims regarding product performance

topics.topic: Comprehensive Termly Marketing Revision & Product Pitch Presentations
learningObjectives: Review key principles of product design, pricing formulas, and salesmanship techniques
Conduct mock product pitch presentations before student panels with peer critique
Practice past WASSCE and NECO Marketing Paper 1 objective and Paper 2 essay questions
Administer official SSS 1 Marketing end-of-term examination
Grade theory and objective scripts in accordance with WAEC standardized scoring keys
Record and publish official continuous assessment and examination results
